description: Unit tests for google_breakpad::ELFSymbolsToModule, testing ELF symbol parsing for 32-bit and 64-bit architectures with different endianness.

classes.name: ELFSymbolsToModuleTestFixture
classes.description: Base fixture class for ELF symbol to module tests, parameterized by endianness and value size.

classes.name: ELFSymbolsToModuleTest32
classes.description: Parameterized test class for 32-bit ELF symbol parsing, with tests for no functions, one function, multiple functions, and error cases.

classes.name: ELFSymbolsToModuleTest64
classes.description: Parameterized test class for 64-bit ELF symbol parsing, with similar tests as the 32-bit version.

methods.name: ProcessSection
methods.description: Processes the ELF section and symbol table contents to populate externs.

methods.name: AddElf32Sym
methods.description: Adds a 32-bit ELF symbol to the test section.

methods.name: AddElf64Sym
methods.description: Adds a 64-bit ELF symbol to the test section.
